type2.prompt: When I got to the cinema, the film _____ .
type2.reason: The film started before I got there (earlier past = had + V3).

type2.prompt: Selin was sad because she _____ her phone.

type2.prompt: Murat showed me the car that he _____ two days before.

type2.prompt: Canan couldn't open the door because she _____ her key.

type2.prompt: By the time Deniz called me, I _____ to bed.
type2.reason: By the time signals completion before the call.

type2.prompt: When we reached the café, our friends _____ their drinks.
type2.reason: Friends collected drinks before we reached the café.

type3.prompt: Action 1: Burak bought the bread. Action 2: Burak came home. (after)
accepted: after burak had bought the bread, he came home.
after burak had bought the bread he came home.
burak came home after he had bought the bread.
type3.answerText: After Burak had bought the bread, he came home.
type3.reason: Buying bread happened first (had bought); coming home later (came).

type3.prompt: Action 1: Aylin finished her work. Action 2: Aylin watched TV. (before)
accepted: aylin had finished her work before she watched tv.
before she watched tv, aylin had finished her work.
type3.answerText: Aylin had finished her work before she watched TV.
type3.reason: Finishing happened first (had finished); watching happened second (watched).

type3.prompt: Action 1: The train left the station. Action 2: We got to the platform. (when)
accepted: when we got to the platform, the train had left.
the train had left when we got to the platform.
type3.answerText: When we got to the platform, the train had left.
type3.reason: Train left first (had left); got to platform later (got).

type3.prompt: Action 1: Deniz made a cake. Action 2: The guests arrived. (by the time)
accepted: by the time the guests arrived, deniz had made a cake.
deniz had made a cake by the time the guests arrived.
type3.answerText: By the time the guests arrived, Deniz had made a cake.
type3.reason: Cake making was completed earlier (had made).

type3.prompt: Action 1: Emre lost his card. Action 2: Emre took a taxi. (because)
accepted: emre took a taxi because he had lost his card.
emre took a taxi because he had lost his transport card.
type3.answerText: Emre took a taxi because he had lost his card.
type3.reason: Losing card happened first (had lost); taking taxi was later (took).

type3.prompt: Action 1: They played football. Action 2: They ate dinner. (after)
accepted: after they had played football, they ate dinner.
they ate dinner after they had played football.
type3.answerText: After they had played football, they ate dinner.
type3.reason: Playing football was first (had played); eating was second (ate).

type3.prompt: Action 1: Canan packed her bags. Action 2: Canan left the hotel. (before)
accepted: canan had taken her bags before she left the hotel.
before she left the hotel, canan had taken her bags.
type3.answerText: Canan had taken her bags before she left the hotel.
type3.reason: Taking bags was earlier (had taken); leaving was second (left).

type3.prompt: Action 1: The shop closed. Action 2: Murat arrived. (when)
accepted: when murat arrived, the shop had closed.
the shop had closed when murat arrived.
type3.answerText: When Murat arrived, the shop had closed.
type3.reason: Shop closed first (had closed); Murat arrived second (arrived).

type4.prompt: When I got to the bus stop, the bus left.
